Dear [Madam](../persons.html#1160),[^1]
. . . . .

Yours much obliged,
C. M.

Yonge
P.S., I daresay you may know my name as a Devonshire one, I am a niece of [Mr.

Yonge](../persons.html#1623) of Puslinch.

[^1]: Harris writes that the letter contained a request that Miss Peard should send her a paper on the Jewish Sects for the [Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching](../others.html#81).
